ādīnavadassanañāṇa: [Ādīnavadassana+ñāṇa] (na) CL=7 The wisdom which can concentrate and contemplate the flaw. See - Ādīnavānupassanā.
ādīnavadassanādimukha: [Ādīnavadassana+ādi+mukha] (na) CL=7 It is first and foremost for showing the flaw etc.,.
ādīnavadassitā: [Ādīnavadassī+tā] (thī) CL=7 As used to meditate (concentrate and contemplate) the flaw.
ādīnavadassāvī: [Ādīnava+disa+āvī] (ti) CL=7 One who used to concentrate and contemplate the flaw.
ādīnavadassī: [Ādīnava+disa+ṇī] (ti) CL=7 One who used to concentrate and contemplate the flaw.
ādīnavadesanā: [Ādīnava+desanā] (thī) CL=7 Preaching  the flaw, Sermon which preaches the flaw.
ādīnavajāta: [Ādīnava+jāta] (ti) CL=7 It has the flaw. See - Upaddavajāta.
ādīnavakathā: [Ādīnava+kathā] (thī) CL=7 Speaking about the flaw, Words which express and point out the flaw.
ādīnavakoṭṭhāsa: [Ādīnava+koṭṭhāsa] (pu) CL=7 A portion of flaw, A phrase which expresses the flaw.
ādīnavakāraṇa: [Ādīnava+kāraṇa] (na) CL=7 Cause of flaw, The cause which happens the anger/flaw.
ādīnavamanasikāra: [Ādīnava+manasikāra] (pu) CL=7 Concentrate and contemplate the flaw.
ādīnavapaccavekkhaṇa: [Ādīnava+paccavekkhaṇa] (na,thī) CL=7 Concentreate and contemplate on  the flaw.
ādīnavapakkhika: [Ādīnavapakkha+ika] (ti) CL=7 It is involved in the portion of flaw.
ādīnavapappaṭicchādana: [Ādīnava+paṭicchādana] (na) CL=7 Covering the flaw (or) Concealing the flaw.
ādīnavapariyesanaṭṭhāna: [Ādīnavapariyesana+ṭhāna] (na) CL=7 A place where is to find the flaw.
ādīnavapaṭicchādaka: [Ādīnava+paṭicchādaka] (ti) CL=7 [In Thī  ādīnavapaṭicchādikā] Can cover the flaw (or) can conceal the flaw.
ādīnavapaṭicchādikatta: [Ādīnavapaṭicchādikā+tta] (na) CL=7 As it can conceal the flaw.
ādīnavapaṭisaṅkhā: [Ādīnava+paṭisaṅkhā] (thī) CL=7 Concentrate and contemplate the flaw.
ādīnavappatti: [Ādīnava+patthi] (thī) CL=7 Reached to the state of happening the flaw.
ādīnavasadisatā: [Ādīnava+sadisa+tā] (thī) CL=7 As it likes the poor man.
ādīnavasaññā: [Ādīnava+saññā] (thī) CL=7 Perception that concentrate and contemplate the flaw. (A) The perception which is inclusive in Vipassanā wisdom which can concentrate and contemplate the flaws in the body. (B) It is impermanence of body, consciousness and volitional dhamma , suffering and changing for the worse and destruction which are the flaws , the perception which is happening together with Vipassanā wisdom which concentrates and contemplates on that flaws. See also - Aniccasaññā, ādīnavānupassanāñāṇa.
ādīnavatā: [Ādīnava+tā] (thī) CL=7 As it is happening the flaw, The nature of flaw.
ādīnavavibhāvana: [Ādīnava+vibhāvana] (ti) CL=7 (1) Can show obvious the flaw. (Na) (2) Showing obvious the flaw.
ādīnavavutti: [Ādīnava+vutti] (thī) CL=7 It cause the flaw. See - Ādīnavavicaya.
ādīnavañāṇa: [Ādīnava+ñāṇa] (na) CL=7 Ādīnava Wisdom, (A) Wisdom/perception which can know which is flaw, Vipassanā wisdom which can contemplate and know the flaws (angers/sins) that is the danger such as Viper (snake) , Cobra (snake) that are Tebhūmaka physical form, consciousness , volitional dhamma whch can disgust as the seriously sore. (B) Vipassanā wisdom which can concentrates and contemplates Tebhūmaka physical form, consciousness and volitional dhamma which like the poor people. (Tebhūmaka means it is being living in three realms such as People realm, Deva realm and Brahma realm).
ādīnavañāṇaniddesa: [Ādīnavañāṇa+niddesa] (pu) CL=7 The section which expresses Ādīnava wisdom by detail and elaborate version.
ādīnavānisaṃsadassana: [Ādīnava+ānisaṃsa+dassana] (na) CL=7 (1) Showing wrong and right (or) Showing result/benefit and offense/flaw. (2) Concentrate and contemplate the benefit and flaw. See - Ādīnavānisaṃsadassanavidhi.
ādīnavānisaṃsadassanavidhi: [Ādīnavānisaṃsadassana+vidhi] (thī) CL=7 Plan/arrangement which arranges for meditation for benefit and flaw.
ādīnavānisaṃsadīpaka: [Ādīnava+ānisaṃsa+dīpaka] (ti) CL=7 Can show benefit and flaw.
ādīnavānisaṃsaparidīpaka: [Ādīnavānisaṃsa+paridīpaka] (ti) CL=7 Can show the benefit and flaw.
ādīnavānisaṃsavibhāvana: [Ādīnavānisaṃsa+vibhāvana] (na) CL=7 Show obvious benefit and flaw.
ādīnavānisaṃsāvabodhayoga: [Ādīnavānisaṃsa+avabodha+yoga] (pu) CL=7 It compares with the wisdom which can know (insight) the benefit and flaw.
ādīnavānupassanattha: [Ādīnava+anupassanā+attha] (pu) CL=7 The Benefit which concentrate and contemplate the flaw again and again.
ādīnavānupassanā: [Ādīnava+anupassanā] (thī) CL=7 Ādīnavānupassanā wisdom, Vipassanā wisdom which meditate on the flaw that is , think and appear all life, Yoni etc in (Tebhūmaka physical form, consciousness, volitional dhamma) (as the serious danger). See - Ādīnavañāṇa. (Tebhūmaka means being living in three realms such as People realm, Deva realm and Brahma realm).
ādīnavānupassanāñāṇa: [Ādīnavānupassanā+ñāṇa] (na) CL=7 Ādīnavānupassanā wisdom, Vipassanā wisdom which meditate on the flaw  that is , physical form, consciousness and volitional dhammas are impermanence, suffering, changing for the worse and destruction.
ādīnavānupassī: [Ādīnava+anupassī] (ti) CL=7 One who concentrate and comtemplate it again and again as the flaw.
ādīpana: [Ā+dīpa+yu] (na) CL=7 Catch fire, Burning and scorching.
ādīpeti: [Ā+dīpa+ṇe+ti] (kā,kri) CL=7 Let it burns and scorches.
ādīpita: [Ā+dīpa+ta] (ti) CL=7 It is brilliant (due to burn and scorch).
ādhipaccasavattanika: [Ādhipacca+saṃvattana+iya] (ti) CL=7 It can be made as a chief.
ādhipaccasavattaniya: [Ādhipacca+saṃvattana+iya] (ti) CL=7 It can be made as a chief.
ādhipateyyasavattanika: [Ādhipateyya+saṃvattanika] (ti) CL=7 It can be as the chief.
ādiccarasi: [Ādicca+raṃsi] (thī) CL=7 The light of the sun; Sunlight. Ādiccaraṃsāvaraṇa - See.
ādiccavasa: [Ādicca+vaṃsa] (pu) CL=7 The relative of Sun King. See also - Ādiccabandhu.
ādiyitu: [Ā+dā+ya+tuṃ] (kri,vi) CL=7 To take (or) To accept (or) To believe.
ādīnavānisasadassana: [Ādīnava+ānisaṃsa+dassana] (na) CL=7 (1) Showing wrong and right (or) Showing result/benefit and offense/flaw. (2) Concentrate and contemplate the benefit and flaw. See - Ādīnavānisaṃsadassanavidhi.
ādīnavānisasadassanavidhi: [Ādīnavānisaṃsadassana+vidhi] (thī) CL=7 Plan/arrangement which arranges for meditation for benefit and flaw.
ādīnavānisasadīpaka: [Ādīnava+ānisaṃsa+dīpaka] (ti) CL=7 Can show benefit and flaw.
ādīnavānisasaparidīpaka: [Ādīnavānisaṃsa+paridīpaka] (ti) CL=7 Can show the benefit and flaw.
ādīnavānisasavibhāvana: [Ādīnavānisaṃsa+vibhāvana] (na) CL=7 Show obvious benefit and flaw.
ādīnavānisasāvabodhayoga: [Ādīnavānisaṃsa+avabodha+yoga] (pu) CL=7 It compares with the wisdom which can know (insight) the benefit and flaw.
